priorities.legal: Fields required to establish legal sufficiency, statutory compliance, Miranda documentation, force justification, or charges.
priorities.identity: Names, badge numbers, roles, contact details, and subject identifiers.
priorities.timeline: Dates, times, dispatch sequence, arrival, arrest, force, and clearance timestamps.
priorities.evidence: Facts supporting probable cause, force justification, injuries, scene details, collected items, and witness accounts.
priorities.administrative: Case numbers, classifications, units, supervisors, and routing metadata.
